text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There have been cases, some fatal, of amiodarone hydrochloride overdose. Monitor the patient's cardiac rhythm and blood pressure, and, if bradycardia ensues, a β-adrenergic agonist or a pacemaker may be used. Treat hypotension with inadequate tissue perfusion with positive inotropic and vasopressor agents. Neither amiodarone hydrochloride nor its metabolite is dialyzable.
